name: langgraph-copilotkit-react-monorepo
description: Polyglot monorepo: React product catalog + LangGraph multi-agent + CopilotKit runtime (A2UI) + MCP tool server

scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm setup:python && node scripts/preflight.mjs
scripts.setup:python: uv sync --directory apps/mcp --all-groups && uv sync --directory apps/agent --all-groups
scripts.dev: node scripts/preflight.mjs && concurrently -k --kill-others-on-fail -n mcp,agent,web -c magenta,cyan,green "pnpm dev:mcp" "pnpm dev:agent" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.dev:agent: uv run --directory apps/agent langgraph dev --host localhost --port 2024 --no-browser
